visual_elements.description: Standard Neural Network diagram: Input image (32x32x3) shown as color cube, arrow to flattened vector (3072 elements), then three layers labeled FC1, FC2, Output with parameter counts shown on connections.
CNN diagram: Input image (32x32x3) → Conv1+ReLU+Pool → Conv2+ReLU+Pool → Flatten → FC1 → FC2 → Output. Each stage shows feature map dimensions and parameter counts.
Parameter comparison table showing: Standard NN ~3.6M params vs CNN ~62K params (98% reduction); Max feasible image size: Standard NN ~64x64 vs CNN 224x224+; Feature learning: global vs hierarchical.

imagery: Input cat image shown as RGB color cube (32x32x3) in both diagrams
Feature maps visualized as stacked arrays showing depth dimension
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout (Arial/Helvetica). Title: bold, 36pt, dark red #C00000. Diagram labels: bold, 20-24pt. Parameter counts: regular, 18pt, dark blue #0F0FC8. Comparison table: bold headers 20pt, regular body 18pt. Advantages list: bullet points, 18pt regular text. All text left-aligned within regions unless specified.
animation_state: Fully built - all elements visible simultaneously. No progressive reveal.
recreation_brief:
1. Slide setup: background white #FFFFFF; all text sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica); static slide, no animations or progressive reveals.
2. Place the title text box centered at top, x 25-75%, y 5-12%: exact text 'Standard Neural Network vs Convolutional Neural Network for Image Classification'; Arial bold 36pt; color #C00000; center-aligned.
3. Place the left column header at the top of the left column, x 8-45%, y 15-18%: exact text 'Standard NN Approach'; Arial bold 20-24pt; color #C00000; left-aligned.
4. Place the Standard NN diagram in the remainder of the left column, x 8-45%, y 18-55%: (a) a 3D RGB color cube (faces in pastels #FFCC99, #99FFFF, #FFCCFF, #CCFFCC) labeled 'Input Image (32x32x3 RGB)' in bold 20-24pt; (b) a right arrow to a flat 1-D vector bar labeled 'Flatten to 1-D Vector (3072 elements)'; (c) three vertically stacked layer boxes (fill #E8E8E8, border #BFBFBF) labeled 'FC1', 'FC2', 'Output' top to bottom, joined by downward arrows, each with its parameter text on the connection in dark blue #0F0FC8, regular 18pt: 'Fully Connected Layer 1: 3072 × 1000 = 3,072,000 parameters', then 'Fully Connected Layer 2: 1000 × 500 = 500,000 parameters', then 'Output Layer: 500 × 10 = 5,000 parameters'; (d) below the stack, the text 'Total Parameters: ~3.6 Million' in dark blue #0F0FC8, 18pt.
5. Place the right column header at the top of the right column, x 55-92%, y 15-18%: exact text 'CNN Approach'; Arial bold 20-24pt; color #C00000; left-aligned.
6. Place the CNN diagram in the remainder of the right column, x 55-92%, y 18-55%, flowing left-to-right then downward: (a) the same 3D RGB color cube labeled 'Input Image (32x32x3 RGB)'; (b) right arrow to a stack of 6 feature-map arrays (28x28x6) labeled 'Conv1: 5x5x3 filter, 6 filters → 6 feature maps (28x28x6)' with parameter text 'Parameters: (5×5×3×6) + 6 bias = 456' in dark blue #0F0FC8, 18pt; (c) the label 'ReLU Activation' immediately after Conv1; (d) down arrow to a stack of 6 arrays labeled 'Max Pool 2x2 → 6 feature maps (14x14x6)'; (e) right arrow to a stack of 16 feature-map arrays (10x10x16) labeled 'Conv2: 5x5x6 filter, 16 filters → 16 feature maps (10x10x16)' with parameter text 'Parameters: (5×5×6×16) + 16 bias = 2,416'; (f) the label 'ReLU Activation' immediately after Conv2; (g) down arrow to a stack of 16 arrays labeled 'Max Pool 2x2 → 16 feature maps (5x5x16)'; (h) right arrow to a flat vector labeled 'Flatten → FC Layers'; (i) three stacked boxes (fill #E8E8E8, border #BFBFBF) joined by downward arrows, labeled top to bottom 'FC1: 400 × 120 = 48,000 parameters', 'FC2: 120 × 84 = 10,080 parameters', 'Output: 84 × 10 = 840 parameters' (parameter values in dark blue #0F0FC8, 18pt); (j) below the stack, the text 'Total Parameters: ~62,000' in dark blue #0F0FC8, 18pt. Render every feature-map stack as arrays stacked along the depth dimension using the pastel palette (#FFCC99, #99FFFF, #FFCCFF, #CCFFCC) with #BFBFBF outlines.
7. Place the comparison highlight box full width, x 10-90%, y 60-75%: a 4-row × 3-column table (1 header row + 3 data rows) with white #FFFFFF fill and dark red #8B1A3A borders; header row bold 20pt: 'Metric' | 'Standard NN' | 'CNN'; data rows regular 18pt: 'Total Parameters' | '~3.6 Million' | '~62 Thousand (98% reduction)'; 'Max Feasible Image Size' | '~64x64' | '224x224+'; 'Feature Learning' | 'Global' | 'Hierarchical (edges → textures → parts → objects)'.
8. Place the Key Advantages block full width, x 10-90%, y 78-90%: section header 'Key Advantages of CNN:' in bold 20pt #C00000, followed by exactly 5 bullet points in regular 18pt dark blue #0F0FC8: 'Parameter sharing reduces parameters by 98%+', 'Preserves spatial hierarchy in image', 'Translation invariance through pooling', 'Scales to larger images (224x224x3 feasible)', 'Learns local → hierarchical features (edges → textures → parts → objects)'.
9. Global styling rules: dark red #C00000 for the title, column headers and diagram stage labels (bold 20-24pt); dark blue #0F0FC8 for every parameter count/value (regular 18pt); light gray #E8E8E8 fills for layer boxes; all text left-aligned within its region except the centered title.
